arms.name: Craft v3, subject only
arms.idea: Craft v2 without the staged base: the code goes to the subject

arms.name: Craft v3 + vehicle samplers
arms.idea: craft3 with the catalogs/ part-family samplers appended as read-only recipes, and an instruction to build the pitch's own vehicle on them

arms.name: Craft v3 + vehicle samplers as inspiration
arms.idea: the sampler arm with sampler2.md: everything is the model's own design and construction; samplers spark ideas and show technique, and their copy instructions are cut

arms.name: Craft v3 + sampler menus
arms.idea: sampler2 with only each sampler's header menu (parts and one line per construction), no code or colours

arms.name: Craft v3 + samplers as inspiration, no materials sampler
arms.idea: sampler2 without materials2077.ts, so no palette or paint code to lift

arms.name: Craft v3 + level of detail
arms.idea: craft3 plus detail.md: every part gets invented details, and those get details of their own; the no-sampler control for detail4

arms.name: Craft v3 + level of detail + four samplers
arms.idea: detail with the four vehicle samplers (truck, tank tracks and armour, mounted weapons, sci-fi hull) as inspiration, no materials sampler
